purpose: First deep-authorship calibration pilot after the surface-SVM lane was disconfirmed for the current Joel/Dharma register. Evaluate LUAR mean-document profiles with nearest-profile cosine under both whole-document and equal-50-word matched-platform conditions.

model.revision_reason: This verified LUAR-MUD revision pins its upstream sentence-transformer backbone revision in config, reducing silent dependency drift.
model.document_profile_rule: Embed each document as a one-document LUAR episode; compute the arithmetic mean of raw training-document embeddings for each author; classify each held-out document by maximum cosine similarity to the three author means.

whole_document.joel_rule: The two Joel-only Dharma supplements plus every non-held-out Joel matched-queue document, including the short Anatta fragment, for six documents per fold.
whole_document.control_rule: Six largest non-overlap explicit-speaker Dharma documents per control.
whole_document.tokenization: Each document is truncated by the LUAR tokenizer at 512 tokens.

equal_50_word.joel_rule: Lucid Dreaming plus the three non-held-out matched Joel documents that have at least 50 words. Exclude the 13-word Anatta and 47-word Sound/Bahiya fragments.
equal_50_word.control_rule: Four largest non-overlap explicit-speaker Dharma documents per control, each at least 50 words.
equal_50_word.normalization: Preserve original characters, punctuation and whitespace through the end of the 50th word token; discard the suffix. Held-out documents are normalized identically.

evaluation.cosine_tie_break: author order in this spec, only after exact numeric equality

interpretation.calibration_rule: Do not advance calibration on aggregate accuracy alone. Require useful Joel-specific held-out performance, consistency across whole-document and equal-budget conditions, and follow-up word-order/content-light controls before any operational interpretation.
interpretation.paper_relationship: This implements the deep-authorship direction used in the idiolect-erasure research integration: LUAR representations, mean author profiles, and nearest-profile cosine. It is a closed-set original-authorship pilot, not an original-vs-rewrite IER experiment.
